items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: And the background voices was Calvin LeBlanc, Willie Harper, and Benny Spelman.

ctx.x: And that song later went on to be a rather well known rock song by the Yardbirds, the middle 60s. On Mother-in-Law, did you have, did you have both Benny Spelman and Ernie Cato in that?

Right. That's an incredible combination. Well, Benny Spelman had the type of voice that could do that. That low part would need that. And it was Ernie Cato's record, actually. And the background voices was Calvin LeBlanc, Willie Harper, and Benny Spelman.
You had to leave minute records for the Army. What happened? Were you drafted in 1963?
